description: Initiative data model and API fully support `depends_on: ["<initiative-name>"]` with validation (unknown-name check, cycle detection, normalization — all tested). The JSON response from `swarm-manager initiatives get` includes depends_on when set. But: (1) CLI default human output does NOT display depends_on; (2) UI likely does not display it (verify during implementation). This is a display-only fix across two surfaces. Downstream effect: operators reading the human output can't see cross-initiative dependencies, which is critical for reasoning about the portfolio readout (e.g., web-console-readiness depends on continuous-audio-platform — this structural information is invisible today unless you read raw JSON). Surfaced 2026-04-24 walk; initially misdiagnosed as a data-model gap, corrected to display-only after code inspection. Scope is small — add `Depends on: a, b, c` line to the human output of `initiatives get` and `initiatives list`, and surface in UI initiative detail + list views.
name: swarm-manager-initiative-depends-on-display
title: Display initiative depends_on in CLI human output and UI
